records.project_scope: Renovation of Oglethorpe House at the University of Georgia. The project addresses aging building systems and facility deficiencies and upgrades the residence hall to current code, accessibility, life safety, and operational standards. Planned measures include more ADA-compliant rooms, replacement of elevator equipment with a stretcher-compliant cab, stairwell pressurization systems, an emergency generator, a fire command center, modernization of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems, and reconfiguration of common areas such as the main lobby and lower-level spaces. Student amenities include large meeting rooms, reconfigured study and meeting areas, lounges with kitchenettes on all floors, a larger community kitchen, and a redesigned laundry room functioning as a multipurpose lounge. Scope within residential rooms and exterior elements is limited to complement prior improvements.
